prompt:
Create a high-fidelity mobile landing page for the fictional Minsk coffee roastery «Кварта», edge to edge on a 9:16 portrait canvas, showing a usable opening and the beginning of the catalog. Render crisp readable Russian text without a browser window, phone frame or surrounding desk.

The webpage is a neighborhood workshop noticeboard. Deep bottle-green painted ground carries ONE oversized off-white uncoated workshop notice. This single notice organizes the whole opening in one full-width vertical reading path: expressive sturdy Cyrillic sans lettering, restrained melon print and quiet ordinary text. The wordmark and Thursday-to-Friday schedule establish the dominant focal move; the actual offer follows, then the directly usable callback slip belongs to the same notice. Keep content aligned and coherent, with ordinary generous reading sizes. The opening notice contains text and form controls only. No product pack, photography, illustration, icon benefits, separate hero column, parallel cards or scattered notes anywhere inside it.

The visitor requests fresh coffee beans for home or office through a manager callback. Use «Кварта», «Ваш кофе. Соседняя обжарка.», «В четверг обжариваем — в пятницу привозим», «Кофе от 26 BYN», «Подписка · 54 BYN / месяц». Small batches are 5 kg. Above the notice, navigation reads plainly as links: «Кофе», «Подписка», «Доставка».

The notice’s single-column form has visible labels above generously sized empty controls: «Имя», «Телефон». Then ONE mutually exclusive interest group: «Разовый заказ», «Подписка», «Вопрос». Include one optional «Комментарий» field, «Перезвоним и поможем с выбором» and a prominent «Оставить заявку» button.

Below the notice, begin a quiet plain catalog list headed «Что обжариваем»: «Эфиопия Иргачеффе · 250 г · 32 BYN», «Цветы, бергамот». A small product thumbnail appears only beside this catalog entry, below the notice. No new motifs, extra tasting claims, contact details or invented claims. The notice is a working webpage, never a decorative poster.
